Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Shah Capital Management Upped Aegean Marine Petroleum (ANW) Position by $1.55 Million; One Capital Management Has Cut Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $626,314 as Market Value Declined 
April 5, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Himanshu H. Shah increased its stake in Aegean Marine Petroleum (ANW) by 81.45% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shah Capital Management bought 388,290 shares as the company’s stock declined 53.66% with the market. The hedge fund run by Himanshu H. Shah held 865,000 shares of the oil refining and marketing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.72 million, up from 476,710 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shah Capital Management who had been investing in Aegean Marine Petroleum for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $94.49 million market cap company. The stock decreased 1.06% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $2.33. About 19,525 shares traded. Aegean Marine Petroleum Network Inc. (NYSE:ANW) has declined 83.33% since April 5, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 94.88% the S&P500. 
One Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. One Capital Management Llc sold 3,706 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,608 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.86M, down from 38,314 at the end of the previous reported quarter. One Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $876.99B market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $1.23 during the last trading session, reaching $172.84. About 7.22 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 5, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
One Capital Management Llc, which manages about $676.36 million and $499.08M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (IJS) by 3,038 shares to 68,221 shares, valued at $10.48M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (MUB) by 19,637 shares in the quarter, for a total of 99,551 shares, and has risen its stake in Ishares Tr (IJT). 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. It increased, as 50 investors sold AAPL shares while 1023 reduced holdings. 151 funds opened positions while 637 raised stakes. 2.98 billion shares or 0.18% more from 2.97 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. First Commonwealth Fincl Corp Pa owns 41,327 shares. Sabal Trust Co reported 122,619 shares. Main Street Research Ltd Llc holds 2.88% or 111,648 shares. Provise Management Limited Company reported 1.04% stake. Schroder Inv Management Group reported 6.10M shares. Seaward Mngmt Limited Partnership holds 712,251 shares. Community Savings Bank Na stated it has 108,326 shares. 15,600 were reported by Peloton Wealth Strategists. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 15.94 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
